li.label: closed-door seclusion
li.description: My own room, the door shut, nobody else. This is how cultivation should be. The monks of the Silent Lotus wall themselves in for forty-nine days; today I understand why.

li.label: too many people
li.description: So many voices, so many breaths in one room. I cannot hear my own qi. Not even a rogue cultivators' night market is this loud.

li.label: highest realm in the colony
li.description: Nobody here is above me. As it should be. Word of this will reach my clan.

li.label: someone above my realm
li.description: Someone here has surpassed me. Me! Do they know who my father is? I will remember that face until the next sect tournament.
